api: QuickBooks Online Accounting API qbo product operations (Intuit EntityJsonObject_v1)
scope: Complete r2 official operation ledger for the QuickBooks Online Accounting API qbo product operations mapped by the connector audit: 43 ETL/read rows, 60 reverse-ETL write rows, 32 bounded direct/provider-query/search rows, 25 binary/file/report rows, and 1 CDC/changefeed row. Current executable coverage remains the five legacy-compatible Query API streams (Customer, Invoice, Payment, Account, Vendor); every other official row is blocked by default until typed schemas, bounds, redaction, idempotency, fixtures, and shared-runtime support are present. Excludes qbpayments, qbdesktop, qbtime, and QuickBooks GraphQL per parent issue #3094.
